text: [VAR 1003][VAR 0100(0000)]!\nThanks for coming, but I’ve got a handle on this!\r\nWhatever’s making that noise, I’ll see to it![VAR 0114(0004)]
I already told you, didn’t I?\nKeep your eye on the goal!\r\nAnd for you, that’s winning the Gym Challenge![VAR 0114(0004)]

The only Gym Badge left is the one you’ll get
from the Dragon Gym’s Leader, Raihan. Right?\c
Raihan is the only Trainer out there I consider a
real rival. He’s that good, you know![VAR 0114(0004)]

And there I go again! Sorry, but I suppose this is
no time for me to be stopping for a chat.
There’s a bit of trouble here with my name on it.\c
But don’t you worry about a thing![VAR 0114(0004)]
The unbeatable Champion is here to look after\nthings and keep you all safe![VAR 0114(0004)]
That came from the tunnel, wouldn’t you say?\nSeems I’m about to have a champion time![VAR 0114(0004)]
